title: 折りたたみ式ごみ集積ボックス
description: 住宅地のごみステーションに置く、緑色の網目ボックスです。角柱と上下の枠、溶接金網の4面、蝶番付きの網ふたと取っ手、前面の留め金、無地の掲示板、脚部パッドを造形しています。ふたは閉じた状態で、折りたたみ・開閉動作、ごみ袋、文字の掲示は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.260 × 0.943 × 0.898 m、32,528三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A green welded-mesh refuse collection cage for residential collection points. It models corner posts, top and bottom frames, four mesh walls, a hinged mesh lid with grab handle, front latch, a blank notice plate and foot pads. The lid is shown closed; folding or opening motion, refuse bags and lettered notices are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.260 × 0.943 × 0.898 m; 32,528 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
